caveats: Baseline pools (per day of year) collected SST from every date within +/-5 calendar days of the 1992-01-01..2002-12-31 baseline dates, so the extended days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 were included, as specified; reported as baseline_analysed start/end. Day of year uses the fixed calendar mapping (29 Feb = 60, Dec 31 = 366). Threshold = 90th percentile of each pool with numpy method='hazen' (0-based index n*p-0.5, NaNs ignored); climatology = pool mean (NaNs ignored); day 60 set to the mean of days 59 and 61; then both arrays (366 days) smoothed with a centred unweighted 31-day moving mean wrapping the year. Region contains 3600 grid cells (60x60); 311 cells with non-finite SST on at least one target day (land) were excluded from the analysis and set to 0 in the mask; the remaining 3289 sea cells had finite SST on all 92 target days and finite smoothed thresholds throughout the target window. All 92 target days (2007-06-01..2007-08-31) were available and analysed. One regional event (2007-06-01..2007-06-27) begins on the first target day; per the method, MHW detection used target-period days only.
